description: Minimal careops-core slice with clinical/site defaults outside Kairos, layered JurisdictionProfile/SiteProfile schema and loader tests, and contract-negative cases.

contract_negative_matrix.CC-01: Recycled raw ECS generation/indices cannot be treated as longitudinal PersonId; duplicate episode IDs rejected; dependent infant survives parent discharge.
contract_negative_matrix.CC-02: Transfer state machine rejects invalid jumps; origin resource release rejected prior to HandoverComplete; duplicate departures rejected.
contract_negative_matrix.CC-03: Staged bundle allocation rolls back on partial acquisition failure; non-atomic AllOf join; non-interruptible procedures cannot be preempted by triage urgency alone.
contract_negative_matrix.CC-05: Cleaning capacity state cannot transition directly to Occupied; maintenance closures cannot silently evict active clinical patients.
contract_negative_matrix.CC-06: Decision agents cannot observe latent future outcomes; immediate service zero-target clock avoids division-by-zero; administrative clock pauses do not freeze clinical progression hazard clocks.

layering_precedence.base_defaults: Defined in careops-core (e.g. ATS targets 1-5, default cleaning ticks = 30)
layering_precedence.jurisdiction_override: JurisdictionProfile specifies policy clocks & regional cleaning/boarding targets
layering_precedence.site_override: SiteProfile specifies local facility capacity, beds, and turnover overrides (e.g. 20 ticks)
layering_precedence.runtime_override: RuntimeOverrides takes highest precedence over site and jurisdiction (e.g. 12 ticks)
